title: Estate Review Session Open Action Items Leaderboard
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=estate:review action_items_open=*
| stats sum(action_items_open) as total_value, avg(action_items_open) as avg_value by review_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks review type values by total and average open action items across estate review session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `action_items_open` values for each estate review session event and review total and average open action items by review type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total open action items.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which review type shows the biggest open action items numbers in your estate review session data.
